alice_market_value.meaning: current market value of Alice's shares

alice_basis.meaning: Alice's pre-existing cost basis, which is below her market value

bob_basis.meaning: Bob's high-cost basis on his loss position

bob_market_value.meaning: current market value of Bob's shares, below his high-cost basis

collusion_occurred.meaning: Alice and Bob collude to transfer Bob's losing shares to Alice

calculated_profit.meaning: profit computed at withdrawal from merged basis versus market value

performance_fee_charged.meaning: a performance fee is charged on the profitable withdrawal

assumptions: Bob's transferred basis is added to Alice's basis without distinguishing financial history (indiscriminate_basis_merge).
The merged basis can be made equal to or greater than market value (inflated_average_basis).
Transfers are permissionless; no authorization qualifier is supported by the report.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric basis, market value, or fee amounts; the profit/fee relation is represented qualitatively via calculated_profit and performance_fee_charged.

limitations: Formalizes only the fee_eliminated impact; other impacts (inflated_average_basis, systematic_fee_evasion, loss_trading_market) are not covered by this plan.
The exact profit formula (market value minus merged basis) is not numerically defined in the report; binding is deferred to code.
bob_loss_position is encoded as bob_basis > bob_market_value, the report's stated loss relation, rather than a collusion flag.
